headline: Gold and silver flat today after a fall over the past week
summary: India's 24K gold is at ₹13,762 per gram and silver at ₹1,95,000 per kg, both unchanged from the previous rate today. Over the last 7 days gold 24K is down 4.14% (₹595 per gram) and silver is down 4.88% (₹10,000 per kg), while across the 21 days of recorded history silver has fallen 11.36% from its high on 2026-10-26. Likely drivers include movements in international prices and the US dollar against the rupee, though the data here does not establish a specific cause.
outlook: Prices showed no change today, so this is a reasonable time to compare rates across jewellers, remembering that making charges and GST are added on top of the quoted rate.
